title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Registries Modernisation and Other Measures) Bill 2019
short_title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Registries Modernisation and Other Measures) Bill 2019

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill is part of a package that would modernise Commonwealth business registers and introduce a director identification number requirement.
The package would allow a minister to appoint an existing Commonwealth body as registrar, with powers and functions set out in existing laws and data standards made by the registrar.

Directors of bodies registered under the Corporations Act or CATSI Act would need to apply for a director identification number before appointment, with transitional arrangements for current directors.
changes: Modernises Commonwealth business registers by creating a flexible, technology-neutral registry regime initially applying to ASIC and Australian Business Register registers.
Introduces a director identification number requirement for directors of bodies under the Corporations Act and CATSI Act.
Gives the registrar powers to issue, cancel and reissue director identification numbers, and to make data standards by legislative instrument.
Creates civil and criminal penalties for directors who fail to apply for a director identification number within the applicable timeframe.
Allows the registrar or a senior staff member to issue infringement notices for such failures.
Provides transitional provisions giving current directors time to apply for a director identification number, with an extra 28 days during the first 12 months.
summary.affected: Directors of bodies registered under the Corporations Act or CATSI Act, and the registrar appointed to administer the new regime.

speeches.speaker: Stuart Robert
speeches.brief: The speaker moved the second reading of a bill that creates core provisions for business registers under the Superannuation Industry (Supervision) Act 1993 and the A New Tax System (Australian Business Number) Act 1999, with these provisions mirrored in the Treasury Laws Amendment (Registries Modernisation and Other Measures) Bill 2019.

speeches.speaker: Stuart Robert
speeches.brief: The bill modernises ASIC and the Australian Business Register onto a single platform administered by the Australian Business Registrar within the ATO, and introduces director identification numbers to prevent phoenixing and other fraudulent activity.

speeches.speaker: Stuart Robert
speeches.brief: The bill was moved for a second reading to allow the registrar to collect fees for registry services under the Treasury Laws Amendment (Registries Modernisation and Other Measures) Bill 2019.
